index.heading: Brand Message Formats — Reference
index.summary: Title block and scope note for the per-brand wire/message format KB page. States it is reference material, not a change request.

index.heading: Message format
index.summary: Per-brand wire formats as they stand today: Mastercard uses ISO 8583 (1987) with brand-specific field 48 usage; Discover uses its own field layout. Field-level mappings live in the format registry.

index.heading: Brand rules
index.summary: States that each brand imposes operational rules on the message contract — mandatory fields, allowed values, certification constraints — enforced by the format layer before dispatch. Names the categories only; no specific rules are listed.
